test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence:

She said, "Don't you understand the seriousness of the matter?"

options.text: She asked why I didn't understand the serious matter.
She asked whether I didn't understand the seriousness of the matter.
She asked if I understood the seriousness of the matter.
She asked do I understand how serious it is.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** In indirect speech, interrogative sentences are converted into statements by using conjunctions like "if" or "whether" and changing the tense of the verb.
 
• **Conversion:**
 
 
• The given direct speech is a yes/no question: *"Don't you understand the seriousness of the matter?"*
 
• To convert to indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" changes to "asked" as it is a question.
 
• The conjunction "whether" is used to connect the question to the main clause.
 
• The tense of the verb "understand" remains in the same tense (simple present) as no time frame change is implied.
 
• The pronoun "you" changes to "I" to match the perspective of the reporting speaker.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Correct Indirect Sentence:** She asked whether I didn’t understand the seriousness of the matter.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She asked if I understood the seriousness of the matter."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She asked why I didn’t understand the serious matter." 
 
 
• Incorrect as "why" is not appropriate for a yes/no question.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She asked whether I didn’t understand the seriousness of the matter." 
 
 
• Grammatically correct but does not match the intended meaning of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She asked do I understand how serious it is." 
 
 
• Incorrect as it does not follow the rules of indirect speech (e.g., incorrect verb tense and structure).
 
 

69:T
